senses.definition: Painstaking and careful not to miss or omit any detail.
examples: The Prime Minister announced a thorough investigation into the death of a father-of-two in police custody.
Not enough! Your work has to be thorougher than this.
It's the most thorough artwork I have ever seen!
The infested house needs a thorough cleansing before being inhabitable again.

quotes.text: Dr. Oldfield once said to me, 'You talk to me quite all right, but why is it that you never open your lips at a committee meeting? You are a drone.' I appreciated the banter. The bees are ever busy, the drone is a thorough idler.
